Gorgeous Getaways Start Here
Awe-inspiring beauty meets old-fashioned hospitality
By nature, half the work was done. Our Red River Gorge lodging and event space blends the benefits of modern conveniences with the scenic views and serenity of Eastern Kentucky. From corporate retreats, to extraordinary weddings, and romantic weekend getaways, Cliffview Resort in Kentucky has something special for everyone.
Watch Video
Guest Rooms at The Lodge
The Lodge at Red River Gorge features 16 bedrooms, and sleeps up to 64 people. It provides space for large groups to rent in its entirety or individual rooms for those that desire the privacy of a separate room at the end of the day.
Book a room
Luxury Mega Cabins
Our two mega cabins feature 11-12 bedrooms, a full kitchen and an entertainment room. Choose between two different layouts. Both Red River Gorge luxury cabins are ideal for groups looking to rent an entire cabin for an all-in-one getaway.
Book a cabin

The Perfect Place to Relax and Unwind
After you explore the beauty of the backcountry and enjoy all the fun adventures Kentucky has to offer, you’ll want a cozy retreat to come home to. That’s why we go to great lengths to offer the finest Red River Gorge lodging. Our complete collection of luxury cabins, rustic suites, and large group retreats are perfect for any traveler. Whether you’re looking for a romantic getaway or a family vacation, we have the perfect lodging option for you and your traveling companions.

Guest Rooms At The Lodge
Perfect For Individual Getaways Or Romantic Weekends
Rustic Charm Surrounded by Captivating Scenery
Looking for accommodating Red River Gorge lodging but don't want to rent an entire cabin? You've found the perfect place. Spend a couple nights with us in your own room at The Cliffview Lodge while you're exploring the Gorge, Natural Bridge State Park or Daniel Boone National Forest (or just getting away from everything for a bit).
Make a Reservation
Individual room reservations are only available within 90 days of your booking date. To inquire about an individual room reservation that is more than 90 days from now, please contact us.
Click here for other accommodations options.
Standard Room
Room includes two (2) queen-size beds, full private bathroom, free continental breakfast & access to the communal wrap-around porch.
Book Now
Queen Room
Our Queen Suite is 100 sqft larger than our Standard Room and includes two (2) queen-size beds, full private bathroom, & free continental breakfast. However, there is no private access to the communal wrap-around porch.
Book Now
King Room
Our King Suite is 100 sqft larger than our Standard Room and includes one (1) king-size bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower, & free continental breakfast. However, there is no private access to the communal wrap-around porch.

Other Great Places to Stay in the Gorge
Red River Gorge Vacation has so many options for your stay. In addition to single-room and group reservations at Cliffview Resort, we also offer single room reservations at the following locations.
If you’d like to book an individual room further out than 90 days, consider these comfortable and convenient options.
Three Rivers Inn
Boutique rooms located just 20 minutes from the trails and activities in the Red River Gorge.
View Rooms
Red River Gorge Inn
Conveniently located on the Bert T Combs Mountain Parkway, everything you need to relax after hiking, climbing, or sightseeing.

Group Lodging
An Unforgettable Group Experience
Comfortable Lodging in a Beautiful Forest Setting
Plan your next event without the extra burden of managing where everyone is going to stay. The hospitable team at Cliffview will help sort out the details in order to provide a space that’s best suited for the needs of your group. Whether you're looking to rent the entire resort as a rustic wedding venue or rent a cabin for a family reunion, our venue is the East Kentucky gem you’ve been looking for.
The Lodge​
Our 7,000+ sqft lodge features 16 bedrooms, and sleeps up to 62 people. It provides space for large groups to rent in its entirety or individual rooms for those that desire the privacy of a separate room at the end of the day.
Learn More
Large Group Cabins
Our two 5,700+ sqft mega cabins feature 11-12 bedrooms, a full kitchen and an entertainment room. With two separate layouts to choose from, The Lakeside and The Retreat are ideal for groups looking to rent an entire cabin for an all-in-one getaway.

Venues & Catering
From company meetings and seminars to family events and weddings, our two event venues, the Conference Center and Reception Hall serve as versatile spaces with catering available.
Red River Gorge Ziplines
We share properties with an award-winning zipline course - Red River Gorge Ziplines. Enrich your stay with a thrilling adventure and save 20% when you stay at Cliffview!
Conference Center​
From company meetings and seminars to social events and small weddings, the Cliffview Conference Center & Banquet Hall is an ideal choice for groups up to 80 guests.
Learn More
Reception Hall​
Use our recpection hall to really make your event shine. At 7,000 sq. feet the Reception Hall offers a full kitchen and seating for up to 250 - an exemplary venue for small conventions and large weddings.
Learn More
Catering​
Freshly prepared breakfast, lunch, or dinner is available to be served buffet-style or individually plated. Our diligent service team will take care of your guests, from set-up beforehand to clean-up afterward. So you can focus on what matters most at your event!
